evidence_checked.subject: Publication and failure semantics
evidence_checked.result: The fixture stages journal output in a unique file in the destination directory and renames only after successful output. Creation, output/redirection, rename and barrier-timeout failures exit 70; publication failures do not fall through to a success receipt. The previous complete journal remains available during staging.

evidence_checked.result: Read read_host_journal, Jobs.submit, binding/state verification and CLI exit handling. Production checks remain unchanged. Repeat submission now explicitly requires CLI success. The regression requires a string operation ID, preservation of that ID, existing_operation, one Host run and a complete running journal.

evidence_checked.subject: Controlled before/after evidence
evidence_checked.result: Verified ROOT-CAUSAL-PROOF.json, capture hashes and native stdout consistency. Before repair, the paused live-file writer produces an empty journal, CLI exit 1 and custody_lost without an operation ID. After repair, CLI exit is 0 and the repeat preserves its original operation ID with one Host run. The regression body is byte-identical before/after; the Events test function is byte-identical to baseline.

evidence_checked.subject: Gate custody and cleanup
evidence_checked.result: Verified all ten referenced gate-record hashes, log hashes, source pins and successful exits. Composition and bounded parallel runs each pass eight tests; saved-output validation passes seven tests covering 209 responses. The before regression fails at the intended CLI-success assertion after releasing the barrier and collecting the Host. Custody records report no remaining processes. Reviewed fixture shutdown and the bounded barrier.

limitations: This accepts the bounded fixture repair for review purposes only; implementation acceptance, integration and publication remain root-owned.
